text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- After 42 years, Algeria's independence war still inspires people to defend citizens' freedom and national sovereignty.
- President Zeroual decorates former independence fighters.
- National Liberation Front party endorses draft constitution.
- Except for Moslem fundamentalist Hamas party, political groups announce positions on referendum to amend constitution on November 28.
- Prime Minister Ouyahia starts six-day visit to African states.
- Italian state-run exports agency SACE will resume financial support for Italian exporters to Algerian market.
